description: Mobile share-flow assertions for TestSprite generated UI tests.
steps: Open the app at the configured base URL.
Locate the Share this game panel.
Assert documentElement.scrollWidth is not greater than clientWidth by more than 1px.
Assert one of these visible states appears: Share sheet opened, Room link copied, Copied with fallback clipboard, or Select the link and copy it manually.
fallbackVisibleText: Select the link and copy it manually.
